one_liner: Derrick White shoots 88.2 percent from the free-throw line while scoring 17.2 points per 36 minutes -- elite touch attached to a modest scoring role.
three_things: The touch is real: 88.2 percent at the line and 36.7 percent from three.
The role is not scoring-first -- 5.5 assists and 4.7 rebounds per 36 next to the 17.2 points.
Opportunity was not the constraint: 7,576.2 minutes over 226 games.
context_note: Per-36-minute rates over a 3-season sample (seasons_played: 3), not per-game and not full-career figures. The manifest is descriptive_only: no adjustment for opponent, teammates, role, or shot difficulty, and a career_min_minutes>=800 inclusion floor applies. Games and minutes measure availability, not how well those minutes were used.
